{{Quote|Greetings, citizen. Welcome to the Woostri Holoscan Database. How may I assist you?|Kelon|<ref name="SETSB" />}}
'''Kelon''' was the [[Chief Directory Assistant]] of the [[Woostri HoloScan Database]],<ref name="SETSB" /> a [[Library/Legends|library]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]].<ref name="Last Command">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> They had a [[Borg Construct Aj^6]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] headband, which they used to access information for work. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kelon assisted an individual who requested information on citizens of the planets [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] with respective [[sub.ref]]s to the planets' [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="SETSB" />

After accessing their database, finding and displaying those results, Kelon asked if the individual wanted to narrow the search before they were given new search parameters to link existing matches to known movements of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. Kelon followed through with the search and went on to access and display those results as well. A [[Human/Legends|Human]], Kelon had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|eyebrows]] with a black goatee. They [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a gray-and-black [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="SETSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kelon was mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SETSB" />
